mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases do not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between UNRATE decrease and subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between HOUST increase and subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which boosts liquidity and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances during easing cycles, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decrease and subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the joint effect of RSAFS increase and UNRATE decrease on subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between PAYEMS increase and subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment (UNRATE).
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases > 1% YoY and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the joint effect of GDPC1 decrease and UNRATE increase on subsequent returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
